name: Landfall
description: The transport went down short of Ashgate. Grab the flight recorder, fight up the high street, through the checkpoint and the square, and make the helipad before the evacuation bird leaves.
briefing: Your transport went down on the approach to Ashgate. The pilot did not make it.
Recover the flight recorder from the wreck: it holds the routes for every evacuation run out of the city.
Fight up the high street, get the checkpoint gate open and clear the square. The bird lifts off the helipad in twelve minutes, with or without you.
debrief: Bird is lifting. Good work, squad. That recorder is going to get a lot of people out.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Rook, this is Command. Your bird is down short of Ashgate. Pull the flight recorder out of that wreck and get to the street gate before they smell the fuel.
radio.done: Recorder secured. The street gate is open: move.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The high street runs straight to the army checkpoint. The pharmacy on the right still has supplies if you can get the door down.
radio.done: Checkpoint ahead. Its gate is dead.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Gate's on its own generator. Start it up and keep them off it.

objectives.label: Hold the checkpoint while the gate opens

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Gate's grinding open. Every one of them heard that. Hold!
radio.done: You're through. The square is crawling.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the square

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Those growths in the square are breeding them. Burn all three or the pad will never be clear.
radio.done: Nests are down. Something big is coming out of the rubble.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Brute in the square! Stay off its line and keep shooting.
radio.done: It's down. The pad gate is open.

objectives.label: Hold the pad until the bird lands

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Raven Two, forty seconds out. Keep that pad clear for me.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Wheels down! Everybody on, now!

name: Yard Sweep
description: Clear the yard, secure the gate and hold it until the convoy is through.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: The yard's crawling. Thin them out so the convoy has a chance.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the sheds

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Three nests down by the sheds. While they stand, this never ends.

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Convoy here, we're at the north gate. Can't open it from out here!

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Hold that gate while they cycle it. Here they come!

objectives.label: Stop the Brute before it reaches the trucks

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Big one coming up from the south! It's heading straight for the trucks!

objectives.label: Survive until the convoy is through

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Last trucks moving. Forty seconds, give us forty seconds!

briefing: A supply convoy is stuck outside the freight yard and the dead have found it.
Thin the horde, burn the nests in the sheds and get the north gate open. Then keep the yard clear until the last truck is through.
debrief: Last truck is through. The yard is yours, and the city eats tonight.

name: Power Out
description: Ashgate's substation went dark. Restart the generators, keep the transformer alive while the grid comes back, then get out.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Substation's dead and so is half the city. Get me inside the fence.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Three generators: west, east and south. They take a while to catch, and they're loud.
radio.done: All three running. The turrets have power.

objectives.label: Clear the nests by the fences

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Nests in the south corners. They'll swamp the transformer if you leave them.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Transformer's spinning up. Ninety seconds. Don't let them touch it!

objectives.label: Put down the Brute at the gate

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: A Brute is sitting on the north road. That's your way out.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Road's clear. Get out before the whole district wakes up.

briefing: The substation that feeds the east side has gone dark. Without it the shelters lose their lights and their fences.
Restart its three generators, clear the nests around the yard and keep the transformer alive while it spins up. The noise will bring everything for a mile.
debrief: Power is back on the east side. Fences are live. Get home.

name: Survivors
description: Two depot workers are holed up inside. Break in, find them, walk them to the truck. The doors lock behind you.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The depot's front lot is full of them. Clear it and get the west gate open.

objectives.label: Find them on the office cameras

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The office terminal still has the camera feeds. Find out where they are.
radio.done: Got them. One in the cold room, one up by the north stairs.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the warehouse

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Two nests between you and them. Burn them or you'll never get them out.
radio.done: Nests are gone. Go get them.

objectives.label: Walk the survivors to the truck

radio.speaker: Survivor
radio.start: Is someone there? Please, we can hear them on the roof...
radio.done: We're with you. Thank you, thank you.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the dock

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: There's a Brute on the loading dock, right by the truck. It has to go.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Truck's running. Everyone aboard, now!

briefing: A family has been holed up in the old food depot for nine days. Their radio went quiet this morning.
Break in, find them on the office cameras, burn the nests in the warehouse and walk them to the truck on the far dock. Nobody gets left behind.
debrief: Truck's rolling with everyone on it. Nine days. They made it.

name: Last Stand
description: Hold the centre of the yard against a growing horde, then break out before it closes in.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Column's moving. Hold the centre of the yard and draw them onto us.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Second wave, and they brought screamers. Kill the screamers first!

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Two Brutes coming through the south fence!

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Last of the column. Ninety more seconds!

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Column's clear. North gate, all of you, now!

briefing: The evacuation column is pulling out of the freight yard and the horde is following the noise.
Hold the centre of the yard as long as the column needs. Brutes have been seen in the area. When the last vehicle is gone, get to the north gate.
debrief: Column's clear and the yard's quiet. That was the hardest stand yet.
